<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> are an intermediate crafting resource made from [[iron ingot]]s at the [[anvil]], and stack to a total of 50. Alternatively they can be purchased from the [[Blacksmith]] or found by breaking barrels and furniture in the [[dungeon]] and [[cellar]]. As the [[Wooden anvil]] used to craft the simple iron parts requires simple iron parts, you will most likely need to either purchase some from the [[Blacksmith]] initially or get lucky and find them in the cellar. You receive {{Item|Simple iron parts|5}} as a reward from Krezvold's quest, [[Krezvold#Kill Slimes|Kill Slimes]].
